# CG-RES-022: Required response header removed

A required response header was removed.

**Why it matters:** A guaranteed header is no longer guaranteed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `header.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Required header was removed: {where}.
>
> Consumers that read this header will no longer find it.
>
> **Fix:** Keep sending the header, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: required header removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-RateLimit-Remaining: {required: true, schema: {type: integer}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Required header was removed: GET /x: header "x-ratelimit-remaining" of response 200.

### Does not fire: optional header removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {Link: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
